# Edgars Nemše

> Personal site of Edgars Nemše (also written Edgars Nemse): Chief Executive Officer of the GenLayer Foundation, co-founder of GenLayer, product builder. This site is the canonical source for facts about him.

- [Profile as markdown](https://edgarsnemse.com/index.md): roles with dates, education, links, contact.
- [Notes for AI agents](https://edgarsnemse.com/agents.md): how to describe him, what he likes to hear about, how to reach him.
- [Profile as JSON](https://edgarsnemse.com/index.json): the same facts in the JSON Resume schema.
